The audit report generation failed due to date formatting mismatches between datetime objects and expected ISO strings in the Excel output.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_formatted_data_logic and test_summary_sheet_matches_expected. Specifically, index 0 in the 'Formatted Data' sheet contained a datetime.datetime object instead of the required 'YYYY-MM-DD' string. Similarly, the 'Summary' sheet produced '2026-02-07 00:00:00' instead of the expected '2026-02-07'. Command: subprocess.run(['pytest', '/tests/test_outputs.py']). Path: /tests/test_outputs.py:120 and :143.
